exposure: noninvasive ventilation initiation at NICU admission
cohort: Neonates with respiratory distress admitted to the intensive care unit in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia in 2022.
finding: Determinants of noninvasive ventilation failure included very preterm birth, maternal comorbidity, noninvasive ventilation initiation at NICU admission, oxygen saturation <85% or 85-93%, Apgar score <7 at 5 minutes, and homemade CPAP use.
